canonical_definition:
What it is. In surveyed usage, TableBench is presented as a benchmark for table reasoning, described as covering diverse question types and topics across a wide range of scenarios. As one study puts it, "TableBench presents a challenging benchmark covering diverse question types and topics" (RoT: Enhancing Table Reasoning with Iterative Row-Wise Traversals).

What it is claimed to measure. The recorded claims converge on a single construct: papers use TableBench to measure table reasoning. It is linked to 1 construct, Table reasoning, and to no behavioral indicators.

Space of uses. Papers position it as part of an experimental set of table reasoning datasets. In the reported experiments, it is used alongside WikiTableQuestions and HiTab, and no measurement instrument is linked to it through the recorded relationships.
